description: Call prep PDF pushed to reMarkable root (/) instead of the correct /Meetings folder. David corrected: call prep sheets belong in /Meetings on the reMarkable.
what_was_wrong: Used `rmapi put <file> /` — placed document at root level of reMarkable file tree.
correct_answer: Call prep sheets and meeting-related PDFs should be pushed to `/Meetings` on the reMarkable. Correct command: `rmapi put <file> /Meetings`
recurrence_check: First logged instance. Apply to all future meeting/call prep document pushes.
